Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

(1) **Yes**, the sidebar has a **'Dashboard'** item at the top. It is highlighted in orange, indicating it is the currently active page.

(2) The other items in the sidebar, listed below the Dashboard, are:
*   **New Enrollment**
*   **Student Records**
*   **Fee Records**
*   **Settings**

(3) **Yes**, the main content area is showing a dashboard/overview page. It contains:
*   A welcome header ("Welcome, Admission").
*   Four summary statistic cards at the top (Enrolled Students, This Month, Pending Base Fee, Base Fee Locked), all currently displaying "0".
*   Two main content sections for "Recent Admissions" and "Enrollment by Program" (which are currently empty).
*   A "Quick Tip" notification bar at the very top of the content area.
